facts.text: Incoming undergraduate students receive an Apple MacBook Pro computer and an iPad device upon enrolling.

sources.title: Apple Technology | Moravian University
sources.quote: As an incoming undergraduate student, you'll receive an Apple MacBook Pro® computer and an iPad® device after you accept your offer of admission. This technology is yours to keep throughout your education at Moravian and beyond.

facts.text: Founded in 1742, Moravian University is located in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania.

sources.title: Facts, Figures & Rankings | Moravian University
sources.quote: Founded in 1742, Moravian University is a private, inclusive institution located in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania.
